title: 2016 Trend Report
publisher: Webbmedia Group Digital Strategy (renamed Future Today Institute in 2016)
author: Amy Webb (founder, Webbmedia Group)
series: Trend Report (later Future Today Institute Tech Trends Report)
notes: Partial: the archived transcript covers slides 1-47 of the deck (trends 1-54 and four umbrella pages, D40: Algorithms, Security, Privacy, Video); the report states 81 trends and runs past page 67. Titles of the later pages (49-67) come from the industry index on slides 3-4, without quotes; the index lists page-level titles only, so sub-trends on those pages are missing (17 titles for about 27 trends). The PDF link was never archived. trend_number is the printed "Trend N" where the slide shows a single number. horizon and target_year from the introduction: "the immediate trends that will matter most to you in the coming year".
